description: This class comprises prefabricated buildings, predominantly made of metal and other non-wood material, and their components, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) metal and non-wood buildings are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Components of these buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

name: Prefabricated wood buildings and components thereof
description: This class comprises prefabricated buildings predominantly made of wood, and their components, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) buildings are built in a factory or manufacturing facility; they are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Components of buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

name: Manufactured (mobile) buildings
description: This class comprises manufactured (mobile) buildings. They refer to prefabricated (factory-built) mobile buildings of any material, in full, although some manufacturers offer these buildings in two sections. Manufactured (mobile) buildings are fully assembled when they leave the factory, often ready to move in or use the same day or few days after arriving on the site. They can be relocated although most, in housing, are never moved from their original site. Manufactured (mobile) buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

name: Guns, ammunition and other munitions
description: This class comprises guns, ammunition and other munitions.

name: Hardware
description: This class comprises hardware.

name: Threaded metal fasteners and other turned metal products
description: This class comprises threaded metal fasteners and other turned metal products.

name: Springs and wire products
description: This class comprises springs and wire products.

name: Forged and stamped metal products
description: This class comprises forged and stamped metal products.

name: Non-ferrous metal castings
description: This class comprises non-ferrous metal castings.

name: Other fabricated metal products
description: This class comprises other fabricated metal products.

name: Wood containers and pallets
description: This class comprises wood containers and pallets.

name: Light-gauge metal containers, crowns and closures, and metal strapping and shipping materials
description: This class comprises light-gauge metal containers, crowns and closures, and metal strapping and shipping materials.

name: Plastic bags
description: This class comprises plastic bags.

name: Plastic bottles
description: This class comprises plastic bottles.

name: Foam products for packaging, of polystyrene or polyurethane
description: This class comprises polystyrene or polyurethane foam products for packaging.

name: Plastic packaging film and non-rigid sheets
description: This class comprises plastic packaging film and non-rigid sheets.

name: Plastic packaging materials, n.e.c.
description: This class comprises plastic packaging materials, n.e.c.

name: Paperboard containers
description: This class comprises paperboard containers.

name: Converted paper packaging products
description: This class comprises converted paper packaging products.

name: Glass containers
description: This class comprises glass containers.

name: Medical, dental and personal safety supplies
description: This class comprises medical, dental and personal safety supplies.

name: Signs
description: This class comprises billboard and other signs.

name: Caskets and other related funeral goods
description: This class comprises caskets or coffins, and other related funeral goods which contain human remains.

name: Hand tools, kitchen utensils and cutlery (except precious metal)
description: This class comprises hand tools, kitchen utensils and cutlery, except made of precious metal.

name: Office supplies (except paper)
description: This class comprises office supplies, except printing paper.

name: Batteries and battery chargers
description: This class comprises batteries and battery chargers.

name: Sporting and athletic goods
description: This class comprises sporting and athletic goods.

name: Toys and games
description: This class comprises toys and games, except game software.

name: Jewellery, cut gems, jewellery findings, hollowware and flatware, and other articles of precious metal
description: This class comprises jewellery, cut gems, jewellery findings, hollowware and flatware, and other articles of precious metal.

name: Musical instruments
description: This class comprises musical instruments, and parts and accessories.

name: Other miscellaneous goods
description: This class comprises other miscellaneous goods.

name: Books
description: This class comprises published books, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Newspapers
description: This class comprises published newspapers, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Periodicals
description: This class comprises published periodicals, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Other published products
description: This class comprises published products, except books, newspapers and periodicals, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Recorded music and other sound recordings
description: This class comprises published musical and non-musical recordings, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Recorded movies, television programs and videos
description: This class comprises published recorded movies, television programs and videos, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: System and programming software and software licensing
description: This class comprises published system and programming software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), and licences to use system and programming software or software components to generate revenues. System and programming software are required to manage computer resources and support the production or running of application programs but are not specific to any particular application.

name: Game software and software licensing
description: This class comprises published game software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), and licences to use game software or software components to generate revenues.

name: General application software (except game software) and software licensing
description: This class comprises published general application software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), and licences to use general application software or software components to generate revenues.

name: Transportation of natural gas by pipeline
description: This class comprises transportation by pipeline of natural gas.

name: Transportation of crude oil and other commodities by pipeline
description: This class comprises transportation by pipeline of crude oil, refined petroleum products and other commodities.

name: Road transportation services for general freight
description: This class comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for goods not requiring climate control, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of general freight, is included.

name: Road transportation services for specialized freight
description: This class comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for specialized freight such as bulk liquids and gases; climate-controlled boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; live animals; waste without collection; dry bulk; and other goods that are not packed, large items and loose goods that are contained only by the vehicle in which they are carried. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of specialized freight, is included.

name: Rail freight transportation services
description: This class comprises transportation by rail of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of rail equipment with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

name: Water freight transportation services
description: This class comprises transportation by water of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of water vessels with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

name: Air freight transportation services
description: This class comprises transportation by air of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space. Rental and leasing services of cargo or freight aircraft with operator or crew, are included.

name: Moving services
description: This class comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of household, office and institutional goods, and goods requiring special handling and protection. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Air specialty services
description: This class comprises the provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

name: Postal services
description: This class comprises delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Courier, parcel, and local messenger and delivery services
description: This class comprises station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking; courier and messenger services; and neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items.

name: Urban transit services
description: This class comprises passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Taxi and limousine services
description: This class comprises local limousine services; local taxi services and taxi dispatch services.

name: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
description: This class comprises long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

name: School bus services
description: This class comprises transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Other transit and passenger transportation services by road
description: This class comprises long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus; local passenger transportation by chartered bus; other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route); shuttle service; other local fixed route passenger transportation service by road; special needs urban transit service; and local shared-ride passenger transportation service. Rental or leasing services of road passenger transportation vehicles with operator or driver are included.

name: Rail passenger transportation services
description: This class comprises interurban transportation of passengers by rail.

name: Water passenger transportation services
description: This class comprises coastal and Great Lakes fixed route passenger transportation services by water; and other passenger transportation services by water. Rental and leasing services of water passenger transportation vessels with operator or crew are included.

name: Air passenger transportation services
description: This class comprises scheduled and chartered air passenger transportation services. Rental and leasing of passenger aircraft with operator or crew (wet and damp leasing) are included.

name: Scenic and sightseeing tour services
description: This class comprises services which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest by rail, buses and other ground vehicles, water, and air, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment that is an attraction in itself. May include commentary, admission to sights or guided visits. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

name: Road transportation support services
description: This class comprises services in support of road transportation, such as access to toll roads; towing services; bus terminal services for intercity carriers; drayage services; and snow removal services for roads, highways and bridges.

name: Motor vehicle maintenance and repair services
description: This class comprises maintenance and repair services for automobiles and light trucks; maintenance and repair services for motor homes, travel trailers and campers; and maintenance and repair services for heavy trucks and buses.

name: Rail transportation support, maintenance and repair services
description: This class comprises rail transportation support services; maintenance and repair of locomotives and rolling stock; and maintenance and repair and related services for railway tracks.

name: Water transportation support, maintenance and repair services
description: This class comprises marine facility services; navigational services for marine vessels; marine salvage services; water transportation support services, n.e.c.; maintenance and repair of marine vessels; and marine vessel traffic reporting.

name: Air transportation support services
description: This class comprises air terminal services; and other air transportation support services.

name: Aircraft maintenance and repair services
description: This class comprises aircraft maintenance and repair services.

name: Freight transportation arrangement and customs brokering services
description: This class comprises arranging the international or domestic transportation of goods on a fee for service basis, or facilitating the clearance of goods through customs on behalf of the importer or exporter of the goods. May include advising on regulations and preparing documentation.

name: Other transportation support services
description: This class comprises packing and crating services for transportation or storage; liquefaction and regasification of natural gas; freight loading and unloading services; carpool and vanpool coordination services; and transportation support services, n.e.c.

name: Grain storage
description: This class comprises storage and safekeeping of grain.

name: Warehousing and storage services (except grain storage)
description: This class comprises storage and safekeeping of goods other than grain.

name: Farm products at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for live animals; oilseeds and grains; nursery stock and live plants; and other farm products. Wholesaling services for cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Petroleum and petroleum products, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for crude petroleum oil; automotive fuels; other fuels; lubricating oils and greases; and other petroleum products, n.e.c.

name: Food, beverages, and tobacco products, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for fresh meat and meat products, except canned and frozen; dairy products, except dried, canned, condensed, and evaporated; poultry and eggs; fresh fish and other fresh seafood; fresh fruit and vegetables; other foods; non-alcoholic beverages, except coffee and tea; alcoholic beverages; and tobacco products and accessories, except raw tobacco. Wholesaling services for cannabis-infused edible products are excluded from this class.

name: Personal and household goods, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for clothing and footwear; jewellery and watches; home furniture and furnishings; household appliances; home entertainment equipment; published products and recorded media, except software; sports equipment, toys, hobby goods and photographic equipment; pharmaceutical and medicinal products; and cosmetics and personal care supplies. Wholesaling services for cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Motor vehicles and motor vehicle parts and accessories, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for automobiles, light trucks, and vans; buses, medium and heavy-duty trucks, and truck tractors; recreational and other motor vehicles; tires and tubes; and other new and used motor vehicle parts and supplies.

name: Building materials and supplies, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for lumber, plywood and millwork; electrical, lighting and communication supplies; plumbing, heating and air-conditioning equipment and supplies; paint, glass and wallpaper; hand tools and hardware; and other building supplies.

name: Machinery, equipment and supplies, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for farm and lawn and garden machinery and equipment, and farm supplies; construction and forestry machinery, equipment and supplies; mining and oil and gas well machinery, equipment and supplies; other industrial machinery, equipment and supplies; computer, computer peripherals and packaged software, except game software; electronic components, and navigational and communications equipment and supplies; office, commercial and service industry machinery, equipment and supplies; medical, professional, and industrial safety equipment and supplies; and industrial engines, boats, and other vehicles and transportation equipment, n.e.c.

name: Intermediate products at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for crude wood, pulpwood, wood pulp, and wood waste and scrap; recyclable scrap metal; recyclable paper and paperboard; other recyclable materials; fabric dry goods, leather, yarn and thread; non-agricultural chemicals, and plastic and rubber basic products; metal ores and concentrates and non-metallic minerals; unwrought metals, metal basic shapes, and metal in other forms n.e.c.; and solid fuels.

name: Other goods, n.e.c., at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for stationery and other office supplies; other paper products, and disposable plastic products; household, industrial and janitorial supplies, except chemicals and paper products; luggage, briefcases, knapsacks, and duffel bags; pet food; miscellaneous personal and household goods, n.e.c; and used products n.e.c. Wholesaling services for cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Cannabis products, at wholesale
description: This class comprises wholesaling services for cannabis viable seeds; cannabis vegetative plants; fresh and dried cannabis (buds and leaves); cannabis oil; other cannabis extracts and concentrates; cannabis-infused edible products; and other cannabis products n.e.c., for non-medical and medical uses. Cannabis is bred to contain cannabinoids, in particular the tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) - more than 0.3% w/w (weight for weight) - and cannabidiol (CBD).

name: Wholesale trade commissions
description: This class comprises the services of arranging the buying or selling of merchandise for others on a commission basis at an intermediate step in the distribution chain.

name: Food and beverages at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for fresh food; frozen food; packaged food dry goods; and soft drinks and beverages. Retailing services for cannabis-infused edible products are excluded from this class.

name: Cannabis products, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for cannabis viable seeds; cannabis vegetative plants; fresh and dried cannabis (buds and leaves); cannabis oil; other cannabis extracts and concentrates; cannabis-infused edible products; and other cannabis products n.e.c., for non-medical and medical uses. Cannabis is bred to contain cannabinoids, in particular the tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) - more than 0.3% w/w (weight for weight) - and cannabidiol (CBD).

name: Clothing at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for men's clothing; women's clothing; children's and infant clothing; vestments, costumes, and non-binary and gender-neutral clothing.

name: Jewellery and watches, luggage and briefcases, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for jewellery and watches; luggage, briefcases, knapsacks, and duffel bags.

name: Footwear at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for men's footwear; women's footwear; gender neutral and non-binary's footwear; infant's and children's footwear, and accessories.

name: Home furniture, furnishings, housewares, appliances and electronics, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for indoor home furniture; outdoor home furniture; home furnishings; housewares; home appliances; and home electronics.

name: Sporting and leisure products (except publications, audio and video recordings, and game software), at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for sporting equipment, including bicycles; toys and games; and arts and leisure equipment and supplies, n.e.c.

name: Publications at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for published books, newspapers, magazines, periodicals and other publications.

name: Audio and video recordings, and game software, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for audio recordings, movies, television programs and other video recordings, and game software.

name: Motor vehicles at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for new motor vehicles; and used motor vehicles.

name: Recreational vehicles at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for new recreational vehicles; and used recreational vehicles.

name: Motor vehicle parts, accessories and supplies, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for new motor vehicle tires; new and used motor vehicle parts and accessories; and automotive chemicals.

name: Automotive and household fuels, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for automotive fuels; and household fuels.

name: Home health products at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for pharmaceuticals; eyewear; and home health products, n.e.c. Retailing services for cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Infant care, personal and beauty products, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for infant care products; and personal and beauty products.

name: Hardware, tools, and renovation and lawn and garden products, at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for hardware and tools; renovation materials and supplies; and home lawn and garden equipment and supplies. Retailing services for cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Miscellaneous products at retail
description: This class comprises retailing services for pets, pet food and pet supplies; tobacco products and accessories; home office equipment and supplies, n.e.c.; farm equipment and supplies; equipment and supplies, n.e.c.; and artwork, collectibles, antiques, and used or second-hand merchandise, except motor vehicles and mobile homes. Cannabis products are excluded from this class.

name: Retail trade commissions
description: This class comprises the service of selling and renting merchandise for others on a commission basis at the final step in the distribution process.

name: Repair and maintenance services (except for buildings and transportation equipment)
description: This class comprises repair and maintenance services, except for buildings and transportation equipment. Covers maintenance and repair services for commercial and industrial machinery and equipment; maintenance and repair services for electronic and precision equipment; and maintenance and repair services for personal and household goods.

name: Rental and operating leasing services of motor vehicles
description: This class comprises motor vehicle rental and operating leasing services, without operator or driver.

name: Rental and operating leasing services of computer equipment
description: This class comprises rentals and operating leases of computers and peripheral equipment. May include the licensing of software as part of the rental agreement.

name: Rental and operating leasing services of office furniture and equipment (except computer equipment)
description: This class comprises rentals and operating leases of office furniture and equipment, except computer equipment.

name: Rental and operating leasing services of commercial and industrial machinery and equipment (except office equipment)
description: This class comprises rentals and operating leases of commercial and industrial machinery and equipment (except office equipment), without operator, driver or crew.

name: Rental and operating leasing services of other goods
description: This class comprises rentals and operating leases of other goods.

name: Residential buildings
description: This class comprises residential buildings.

name: Industrial buildings
description: This class comprises industrial buildings. An industrial building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for industrial purposes, including mining buildings.

name: Commercial buildings
description: This class comprises commercial buildings. A commercial building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for commercial purposes, including office buildings.

name: Institutional buildings
description: This class comprises institutional buildings. An institutional building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for institutional purposes.

name: Highways, roads, streets, bridges and tunnels
description: This class comprises highways, roads, streets, bridges, and tunnels.

name: Other land transportation civil engineering works
description: This class comprises other land transportation civil engineering works or infrastructures.

name: Marine engineering works
description: This class comprises marine engineering works.

name: Oil and gas extraction sites and structures
description: This class comprises oil and gas extraction sites and structures.

name: Pipelines
description: This class comprises pipelines.

name: Other oil and gas engineering works
description: This class comprises other oil and gas engineering works.

name: Electric power engineering works
description: This class comprises electric power engineering works.

name: Communications networks
description: This class comprises communications networks.

name: Waterworks engineering works
description: This class comprises waterworks engineering works.

name: Sewage engineering works
description: This class comprises sewage engineering works.

name: Mining engineering works
description: This class comprises mining engineering works such as structures (except buildings), tailing disposal systems and settling ponds.

name: Other civil engineering works
description: This class comprises other civil engineering works.

name: Industrial intellectual property
description: This class comprises industrial intellectual property, such as patents and industrial designs, produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

name: Software originals
description: This class comprises software originals produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

name: Originals protected by copyright (except software)
description: This class comprises originals protected by copyrights, except software, produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

name: Oil and gas exploration
description: This class comprises certain services used in the search for, discovery and initial delimitation of previously unknown pools of oil or gas, or of unproven areas or deeper zones of known pools.

name: Mineral exploration
description: This class comprises certain services used in the search for, discovery and initial delimitation of previously unknown mineral deposits or the re-evaluation of sub-marginal or neglected mineral deposits.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in natural sciences
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in natural sciences. Natural sciences refers to scientific disciplines concerned with understanding, exploring or developing the natural world. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in engineering and technology
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in engineering and technology. Engineering and technology refers to scientific disciplines concerned with understanding, exploring or developing the natural world. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in medical and health sciences
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in medical and health sciences. Medical and health sciences refers to scientific disciplines concerned with understanding, exploring or developing the natural world. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in agricultural and veterinary sciences
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in agricultural and veterinary sciences. Agricultural and veterinary sciences refers to scientific disciplines concerned with understanding, exploring or developing the natural world. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in social sciences
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in social sciences. Social sciences refers to disciplines concerned with the study of human actions and conditions and the social, economic and institutional mechanisms affecting humans. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Research and experimental developmental services in humanities and the arts
description: This class comprises research and experimental development services in humanities and the arts. Humanities and the arts refers to disciplines concerned with the study of human actions and conditions and the social, economic and institutional mechanisms affecting humans. Research services consist of systematic investigation carried by means of experiment or analysis to achieve a scientific or technological advance such as acquiring new knowledge of the underlying foundation of phenomena and observable facts. Experimental development services consist of new or substantially improved goods, services, systems, methods or processes.

name: Custom software design and development services
description: This class comprises software specifically designed and developed for an individual customer, and customization of existing software to meet the specific needs of the customer.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of non-financial intangible assets (except products protected by copyright)
description: This class comprises licences for the use of non-financial intangible assets, except assets protected by copyrights, to generate revenues.

name: Support services for crop production
description: This class comprises support services for crop production, for field crop farms, orchards, groves, greenhouses and nurseries.

name: Support services for animal production, hunting and fishing
description: This class comprises support services for animal production, hunting and fishing.

name: Support services for forestry
description: This class comprises support services related to forestry.

name: Custom work services for forestry
description: This class comprises felling timber for a fee or commission.

name: Support services for oil and gas extraction (except oil and gas exploration)
description: This class comprises support services for oil and gas extraction, except oil and gas exploration.

name: Support services for mining and quarrying (except mineral exploration)
description: This class comprises the construction and set-up of facilities and infrastructure to develop a mine site from the exploration phase to production, and to support the operation of mines and quarries.

name: Construction services
description: This class comprises construction services for buildings and engineering works.

name: Fabric weaving and finishing services
description: This class comprises fabric weaving and finishing services on a fee or commission basis, using raw materials owned by the client.

name: Printing support services
description: This class comprises support services to commercial printers such as binding, and pre-press and post-press printing, on a fee or commission basis, using raw materials owned by the client; and engraving (printing) and platemaking on a fee or commission basis.

name: Contract printing services
description: This class comprises printing services on a fee or commission basis.

name: Coating, engraving, heat treating and similar metal processing services
description: This class comprises coating, engraving, heat treating and similar metal processing services on a fee or commission basis, using raw materials owned by the client.

name: Custom manufacturing services (except printing, finishing of textiles and metals)
description: This class comprises custom manufacturing services, except printing and finishing of textiles and metals, on a fee or commission basis, using raw materials owned by the client.

name: Advertising space in printed newspapers
description: This class comprises provision of advertising space in printed newspapers.

name: Advertising space in printed periodicals and in other printed publications
description: This class comprises provision of advertising space in printed periodicals and in other printed publications.

name: Advertising air time on radio
description: This class comprises provision of air time on conventional radio stations, as well as on satellite, cable and other pay radio stations, to advertisers for the placement of advertising messages.

name: Advertising air time on television
description: This class comprises provision of air time on conventional television channels, as well as on specialty and pay television channels, to advertisers for the placement of advertising messages.

name: Internet advertising
description: This class comprises provision of space for advertising messages distributed over the Internet. Covers the provision of space for banner ads, buttons, text links, interstitials, rich media previews, streaming audio and video ads.

name: Exclusive advertising rights, endorsements, and display advertising
description: This class comprises exclusive advertising rights and endorsement services; and advertising space on billboards, transit and other displays.

name: Advertising intermediary services
description: This class comprises services of intermediaries in the buying and selling of advertising space and time, more specifically the services of acquiring advertising space or time from media owners, for sale to advertisers or advertising agencies; and services of intermediaries in selling advertising space or time in various media for a fee or commission paid by the media outlet.

name: Direct advertising services
description: This class comprises advertising and marketing services that communicate directly with the consumers, without using time or space in media outlets such as newspaper or television. It covers advertising and marketing campaigns communicated by direct mail, door-to-door delivery, distribution of samples in public places, use of advertising specialties, product demonstrations and display lettering. This class also covers full service direct mail advertisement and full service direct advertising.

name: Full advertising campaigns, advertising creative and public relations services
description: This class comprises full-service advertising campaigns; advertising creative services; public relations services; and advertising services n.e.c.

name: Audio recording services and copyright administration
description: This class comprises studio and live sound recording services, support services for sound recording, and copyright administration services.

name: Movie, television program and video production, post-production and editing services
description: This class comprises contract production of audiovisual works; pre-production, production and post-production services for audiovisual works; motion picture film laboratory services; duplication and copying services for audiovisual works. Covers support services for the live production of audiovisual works.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of literary works (except software) and artistic works
description: This class comprises licences for the use of literary works, except software, and artistic works to generate revenues.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of musical works and sound recordings
description: This class comprises licences for the use of musical works and sound recordings to generate revenues.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of dramatic works, and other copyrighted property n.e.c.
description: This class comprises licences for the use of dramatic works, and other copyrighted property n.e.c. to generate revenues.

name: Sporting event media rights
description: This class comprises the right to broadcast a sporting event on traditional electronic media and other media rights related to sporting events.

name: Fees for the distribution of television and radio program channels (affiliation payments)
description: This class comprises the right (affiliation payments) for the distribution of a television or audio channel to end users.

name: Wholesale telecommunications services (carrier services)
description: This class comprises fixed wholesale telecommunications and Internet access services, and mobile wholesale telecommunications.

name: Retail telecommunication services
description: This class comprises fixed retail telecommunications and Internet access services, and mobile retail telecommunications.

name: Broadcasting and online games distribution services
description: This class comprises broadcast distribution services of audiovisual and audio works such as television programs, films, videos, sound recordings, via cable, satellite, Internet and other fixed and mobile distribution streams. Also covers distribution services for online games, except gambling, and installation services for connections to broadcasting distribution networks.

name: Data processing, hosting, and related services
description: This class comprises services such as website hosting, application provisioning, business process management, infrastructure provisioning, network management, and information and document transformation.

name: Other information services
description: This class comprises other information services.

name: Financial system regulatory services
description: This class comprises services provided by central banks, other government agencies, and self-regulatory bodies (such as stock exchanges) to regulate financial systems and markets, and the participants in those systems and markets.

name: Account and cash management products
description: This class comprises money management services, provided to customers by means of deposit accounts, such as chequing, savings and time accounts, and specialized cash management services that enable businesses to handle cash, transfer monies, and in general make and receive payments.

name: Loans
description: This class comprises loans that represent the direct lending of funds under legal contract, either unsecured or secured by the assets being financed or by other assets, but without the exchange or the use of securities as collateral.

name: Credit financing (except loans)
description: This class comprises credit card services; factoring; financial leasing; and sales financing.

name: Other credit financing products
description: This class comprises financing services related to trading and dealing in securities which generally involve the use of securities as collateral or as the lent instrument, as well as other credit financing products, n.e.c.

name: Investment products
description: This class comprises securities origination products; brokering and dealing of financial instruments; and brokerage correspondent products.

name: Personal trust and financial planning services
description: This class comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services intended for private individuals.

name: Trust and financial planning services for businesses, institutions, and government
description: This class comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

name: Products supporting financial services
description: This class comprises management of financial market and clearing products; automated clearing house products; and other products supporting financial services.

name: Pension and annuity products
description: This class comprises underwriting services of plans which provide income payments at regular intervals to individuals or members of groups. Plans may require a single contribution or a series of contributions; may be compulsory or optional; may have nominal benefits determined in advance or dependent on the market value of aspects supporting the plan; and, if related to employment, may or may not be portable with a change in employment. The duration of the period during which benefits are paid may be fixed in terms of a minimum or maximum; there may or may not be survivors' benefits.

name: Life insurance products
description: This class comprises underwriting services of insurance policies which provide for the payment of claims to beneficiaries contingent upon the death of the insured individual or upon the maturation of the policy. Policies may provide pure protection or may also contain a savings component. Policies may cover individuals or members of groups.

name: Health and accident insurance products
description: This class comprises underwriting services for health and accident insurance policies.

name: Vehicle insurance products
description: This class comprises underwriting property and casualty insurance policies related to the operation of personal or commercial vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property, or personal injury.

name: Property insurance products (except vehicle)
description: This class comprises underwriting property insurance policies, except those related to the operation of vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property.

name: Other non-life insurance products
description: This class comprises surety bonds and related products; other liability insurance products; and other direct insurance products.

name: Reinsurance products
description: This class comprises providing reinsurance services to spread the risk of direct underwriting services and retrocession contracts (the reinsurance of reinsurance).

name: Insurance brokerage and other services related to insurance
description: This class comprises insurance brokerage and agency services; claims adjustment services; insurance consulting services; and other services related to insurance.

name: Residential rents
description: This class comprises rental of land for residential use; and rental of residential space in buildings or other facilities, for use as principal residence.

name: Rooming and boarding services
description: This class comprises rental or leasing of space for use as the principal residence of a tenant in rooming and boarding houses. May include additional services, such as housekeeping, meal and laundry services.

name: Non-residential rents
description: This class comprises rental of land, of buildings or other structures, and of space within buildings and other facilities, for non-residential uses.

name: Real estate brokerage and other services related to real estate
description: This class comprises brokerage services for the sale or rental of real estate; real estate consulting, appraisal and listing services; property management services; and services provided by real estate agencies to their real estate associates.

name: Legal services
description: This class comprises legal services concerning criminal and non-criminal law as well as legal support services.

name: Accounting, tax preparation, bookkeeping and payroll services
description: This class comprises auditing and other assurance services; tax preparation and representation services; and bookkeeping, financial statement compilation, and payroll services.

name: Architectural services
description: This class comprises architectural services, including the provision of architectural designs, plans and studies; advisory services; construction documents; construction contract administration; landscape architecture services; and urban planning services.

name: Engineering services
description: This class comprises the design of buildings, industrial structures, civil works, transportation works, power generation and transmission works, machinery, and other works, in order that they implement scientific principles efficiently and safely. The product is presented in the form of designs, plans, studies and advisory services.

name: Services related to architecture and engineering (except surveying and mapping)
description: This class comprises drafting services; building inspection services; testing laboratory services; and project management services.

name: Surveying and mapping services
description: This class comprises the acquisition, processing and interpretation of information about the earth's subsurface, surface and water bodies, presented in the form of data, maps, orthophotos and charts.

name: Specialized design services
description: This class comprises interior design services; interior decorating services; industrial design services; graphic design services; and fashion, jewellery and footwear design services, and other design services n.e.c.

name: Computer systems design and related services (except software development)
description: This class comprises computer network design and development services; computer systems design, development and integration services; information technology (IT) technical consulting services; and information technology (IT) technical support services.

name: Management consulting services
description: This class comprises providing advice and guidance on management issues, such as strategic and organizational planning, finance, human resources, marketing and production.

name: Environmental consulting services
description: This class comprises the provision of information, advice, and guidance to clients concerning the preservation of air, water and soil quality; natural resource development; waste management; pollution control; and other environmental issues.

name: Other economic, scientific and technical consulting services
description: This class comprises economic consulting services; soil management, crop and animal production consulting services; occupational health and safety consulting services; heritage consulting services; and other scientific and technical consulting services, n.e.c.

name: Photographic services
description: This class comprises the provision of photography services, being the taking and production of still photographs and video recordings of individuals, groups, scenes or objects. May take place in a studio or in locations such as school auditoriums. Covers still photographs and video recordings, both chemistry-based and digital.

name: Veterinary services
description: This class comprises prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and health care management services for animals.

name: Other professional, scientific and technical services
description: This class comprises professional, scientific and technical services, n.e.c.

name: Office administrative services
description: This class comprises providing a range of office administrative services to another establishment. At least some of the services are provided on the premises of that establishment. The services that may be provided include billing, record keeping, personnel, secretarial, mail room, and other administrative activities.

name: Employment services
description: This class comprises permanent placement; contract staffing; temporary staffing; temporary staffing to permanent placement; long-term staffing (payrolling) and co-employment services; onsite management of temporary help; online job listing services; executive/retained search; and other employment services.

name: Business support services
description: This class comprises document processing services, and contract publishing services for others; mailroom services, mailbox rentals and mail-presorting services; telemarketing and call support services; debt collection and recovery services; seizure and civil execution services; credit rating services; fundraising organization services; and other business support services.

name: Security and investigation services
description: This class comprises investigation services to provide information about people, events or documents for use in legal proceedings, pre-employment verification, or domestic matters, or for other uses, as well as services to protect people and property provided by the private sector.

name: Cleaning services for buildings and dwellings
description: This class comprises cleaning services for residential dwellings and non-residential buildings.

name: Other services for buildings and dwellings
description: This class comprises pest extermination and control services, and landscaping services for residential dwellings and non-residential buildings.

name: Facilities and other support services
description: This class comprises facilities management support services; and other support services.

name: Water delivered by water works and irrigation systems
description: This class comprises water delivered by water works and irrigation systems.

name: Sewage and dirty water disposal and cleaning services
description: This class comprises sewage and dirty water disposal and cleaning services.

name: Waste management and remediation services
description: This class comprises non-hazardous waste management services; hazardous waste management services; and remediation services.

name: Physician services
description: This class comprises physician services.

name: Other health practitioner services (except physician and dental services)
description: This class comprises other health practitioner services, except physician and dental services.

name: Dental services
description: This class comprises dental services.

name: Medical laboratory diagnostic and testing services
description: This class comprises medical laboratory diagnostic and testing services.

name: Hospital services
description: This class comprises hospital services.

name: Ambulance services
description: This class comprises transportation of individuals by paramedic or higher level medical personnel staffed ambulance services.

name: Other health care services
description: This class comprises health care services, n.e.c.

name: Residential and nursing care services
description: This class comprises residential care services with or without skilled nursing care, residential care services with independent living and rights to occupancy services.

name: Social assistance services
description: This class comprises social assistance services.

name: Child day-care services
description: This class comprises day care services for children.

name: Basic education and skills programs
description: This class comprises pre-primary, elementary and secondary programs and courses providing a formal basic education for children and adults as well as other programs that provide fundamental knowledge and skills needed by individuals to function productively in society.

name: Trade, career, technical and professional development training programs
description: This class comprises programs and courses designed to train, upgrade or for professional development of individuals in the skilled trades or in entry level vocations, career and technical occupation. Programs are generally less than two years in length.

name: Higher career, technical, academic and advanced research qualification programs
description: This class comprises programs and courses in higher technical and theoretical subjects which prepare students for further research or for occupations with high skills requirements. Programs are normally two years or more in length.

name: Leisure and recreational instructional programs
description: This class comprises programs and courses that focus on the development of an appreciation for and competency in recreational and leisure-related activities. These may result in an award or other form of recognition, but do not qualify for academic credit or career qualifications.

name: Educational support and sports coaching services
description: This class comprises services that support educational processes or systems, and students, and sports coaching services.

name: Contract production of live performing arts performances, live sporting events, and copyrighted works
description: This class comprises contract production of live performing arts performances, live sporting events, and copyrighted works.

name: Sport and performing arts event organization services
description: This class comprises planning, organizing, marketing, and managing live sports or performing arts events on behalf of others, including venue owners and performers. This also covers support services for the production of live sports or performing arts events.

name: Career management and representation services of artists, athletes, entertainers and other public figures
description: This class comprises acting on behalf of artists, athletes, entertainers, and other public figures in a wide range of activities that enhance the client's career, including negotiating contracts and bookings for performances and public appearances.

name: Admissions to live sporting events
description: This class comprises admissions to attend live sporting events.

name: Admissions to live performing arts performances
description: This class comprises admissions to live performances of theatrical, musical, dance and other performing artists and companies.

name: Admissions to motion picture film exhibitions
description: This class comprises admissions to exhibitions of Canadian and foreign motion picture films in cinemas and other venues, such as film festivals, drive-in theatres, and film clubs.

name: Amusement and recreational services (except live events and heritage institution services)
description: This class comprises amusement and recreational services (except admissions to live sporting events, performing arts performances and motion picture film exhibitions, and heritage institution services); amusement park and arcade services; and pleasure craft dockage, launching and utilities services.

name: Heritage institution services
description: This class comprises admissions to heritage institutions; travelling exhibits; and public programs of heritage institutions.

name: Gambling (net wagers)
description: This class comprises lotteries; table wagering games; gambling machine products; racing and sporting event gambling products; and Internet gambling products.

name: Prepared meals
description: This class comprises prepared meals and non-alcoholic beverages.

name: Alcoholic beverages for immediate consumption
description: This class comprises wine, wine drinks, beer, ale, malt beverages, and drinks containing distilled spirits, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption.

name: Room or unit accommodation services for travellers
description: This class comprises temporary accommodation for travellers and others, typically comprising rental of a room with bed.

name: Recreational vehicle park and recreational camp services
description: This class comprises temporary accommodation for travellers and others in recreational vehicle parks and recreational camps.

name: Travel arrangement, reservation and planning services
description: This class comprises reservation services for passenger transportation, cruises, lodging, pre-packaged tours and events; event ticket sales and reservation services, and access to global distribution systems; trip planning services; packaged tours; and other travel arrangement and reservation services.

name: Hair care and aesthetic services
description: This class comprises hair care services; nail care services; and skin care services.

name: Funeral services
description: This class comprises pre-burial services for human remains; cremation of human remains; interment of human remains; graves, plots, and other spaces for human remains; cemetery maintenance services; and packaged funeral services for human remains.

name: Laundry, dry-cleaning and related services
description: This class comprises providing laundry, dry-cleaning and related services.

name: Parking services
description: This class comprises providing parking space for automobiles, motorcycles and bicycles, both on-street and off-street.

name: Other personal and personal care services
description: This class comprises pet care services; photo finishing services; hair removal services; tattoo, tanning and other body modification services; weight loss services; non-therapeutic massage services; and other personal services.

name: Babysitting services
description: This class comprises purely custodial care of children, carried out in private residences.

name: Private household services (except babysitting)
description: This class comprises private household services, except babysitting.

name: Labour organization services
description: This class comprises provision of services by labour unions, bargaining associations and trade unions to members, in exchange for union dues and similar payments. Membership in a labour union confers various rights upon the member, for example relating to election of officers and bargaining, and expresses support for the goals of the labour union.

name: Political organization services
description: This class comprises provision of services such as information dissemination, public relations and similar services by political parties.

name: Religious organization services
description: This class comprises provision of services by religious organizations, to members, in exchange for membership dues and similar payments.

name: Other membership organization services
description: This class comprises social advocacy organization services; civic and social organization services; and business, professional and other membership organization services.

name: Federal government public administration services
description: This class comprises the federal government services of a governmental nature, such as legislative, judicial, taxation, national defence, public order and safety, immigration, foreign affairs and international assistance services, and the administration of federal programs.

name: Provincial and territorial public administration services
description: This class comprises the services of provincial and territorial governments that are of a governmental nature, such as legislative, judicial, taxation, and public order and safety services, and the administration of provincial or territorial government programs.

name: Municipal and other local public administration services
description: This class comprises the services provided by municipal and other local governments, such as legislative activities, taxation, public order and safety, and the administration of programs.

name: Indigenous public administration services
description: This class comprises the range of services provided by Indigenous governments to their constituents, services that would otherwise be provided by federal, provincial/territorial or municipal levels of governments.

name: International and other extra-territorial public administration services
description: This class comprises governmental services provided by foreign governments in Canada.
